/blog/shopify-ai-store-builder-custom-ap.hook: Shopify's AI store builder can draft your store in minutes. The work that eats your week starts after launch.
/blog/shopify-ai-store-builder-custom-ap.intro: Case study: the custom Shopify app I built that turns every product update into a branded WhatsApp and Facebook share image.
points: Webhooks and Sharp generate a 1200×628 deal preview automatically
Images live in the merchant's own Shopify Files, not a third-party bucket
A versioned share URL beats the old-preview cache in chat apps

/blog/openai-claude-gemini-api-pricing.h.hook: Price per token is the wrong number for an AI feature. Cost per user is the one your subscription has to cover.
/blog/openai-claude-gemini-api-pricing.h.intro: I compared OpenAI, Claude and Gemini API pricing on a worked support-assistant example and turned it into monthly cost, margin and break-even.
points: Output was 1/6 of the tokens but 62% of the bill
Claude Sonnet 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol cost exactly the same: $648 a month
Budget Gemini 3.8 Flash at its January 2027 price, not the promo
